title: Embed shared agent monitoring with durable ownership and remote access
body:
Refs #31. Guide companion: https://github.com/jimmie-potts/agent-device-hub/pull/112.

Compose released agent-state 1.0.0 inside the existing Pixoo backend. The opt-in monitor has one private durable owner, scoped credentials, bounded ingestion, the existing SSE transport, labels and notice acknowledgment. A selected embedded/remote source keeps consumers on one owner through explicit quiesce/export/import. Monitoring never calls the device writer. Preserve simulator startup as the default and the existing explicitly configured device mode, as confirmed by the owner.

This is a draft because local Linux performance qualification fails the frozen Hub #30 percentile budgets. No budget is relaxed. The active OpenSpec change `gh-31-shared-monitor-host` remains unarchived; source merge and issue closure are blocked. The candidate does not install hooks, change the Nanoleaf installation, operate hardware or publish the guide.

Validation for head `ff993d770b1898973d3a7248917037d3faa451cf`, base/merge-base `9f1c0ec75651810a441606b0c08fbdeee824c8d8`:

- Node 24 `npm run check`: 295 application tests in 48 files, typecheck/lint, 13 current specifications and the active change, plus all 10 workflow fixtures pass. The package regression verifies the archive/manifest/file hashes and executes all 96 upstream Node tests. A separate Python run passed both tests covering the shared 36-case snapshot inventory.
- Browser validation: all 52 tests pass on the implementation; final rerun readback pending at publication.
- Integration coverage includes authenticated admission, privacy, duplicate/prior-turn events, durable labels/notices, child uncertainty, journal bounds, actual interrupted transactions, ownership exclusion, cutover/rollback, remote acknowledgment/filter/feed parity, host loss, SSE capacity/backpressure and bounded producer/measurement failures.
- Three complete 9,000-call measurements remain failed. The latest WAL/FULL run had concurrency-1 p99 up to 104.3 ms against 65 ms and concurrency-50 p99 up to 716.9 ms against 396 ms. Full results and limitations are in `docs/performance/gh-31-embedded-host.json`. Other host workloads were not controlled; this does not establish the cause of the misses. Harness RSS is not standalone-service qualification.
- Independent Standards and Specification rounds resolved invalid filtered snapshots, missing loss notifications and stale-state handling after malformed remote replies. Their subsequent spawn-error cleanup finding is fixed with a passing regression. Final committed-head reassessment remains pending; earlier reviews do not authorize merge.
- Required hosted checks remain all five configured jobs: Workflow Ubuntu/Windows, Application Ubuntu/Windows, and Simulator browser. Branch-protection lookup returns account-plan HTTP 403; procedural gates remain mandatory.

Remaining: establish passing performance evidence without weakening limits, complete applicable OpenSpec tasks/sync/archive, renew independent reviews and all current-head CI, guarded squash merge, successful merged-main checks, and verified issue completion. Guide-source synchronization has its own reviewed companion; public publication is outside this task.

title: Add bounded dashboard transport qualification tools
body:
Refs #30. This source-first candidate adds an offline-default dashboard experiment using complete synthetic 64×64 RGB pictures, latest-picture coalescing, bounded cadence/duration/traffic and the existing serialized adapter. Both protocol CLIs now participate in the backend's local target lock and close transport before releasing it.

Physical mode requires an explicit protocol target, clean source revision, owner/model/firmware record and consent flags. Text/item execution remains unavailable because exact device-font preview and clear semantics are unqualified. The documentation records both candidates, source evidence, restoration limits and the bounded physical procedure. ADR 0015 leaves the measured method/cadence decision pending; no device was operated and #30 must remain open.

Validation for final candidate 893009145a457f3445b88b8f3df2c809cd06b388:

- Node 24.20.0 `npm ci` and `npm run check` passed: 294 application tests and 10 workflow fixtures.
- Focused new-module/CLI checks failed before implementation and passed afterward; tests cover offline defaults, consent/target/bounds, coalescing, deadline, failure/uncertainty, cancellation, payload bytes and competing local ownership.
- Chromium installed; `npm run test:browser` passed all 54 desktop/mobile tests, including exact pixel readback for all eight dashboard previews. Browser inputs are unchanged from the initial tested candidate 3968540. Localhost was excluded from this host's configured proxy for browser validation. Preview screenshot inspected.
- Source OpenSpec synchronized and archived after current status/spec/archive lookups. Final workflow checks passed with 13 specifications and 14 archives.
- Independent Standards and Specification reviews found no P0–P3 findings on this comparison. Standards independently ran 70 focused/adjacent tests; Specification ran 19 focused tests, verified all eight preview buffers in Chromium and checked pinned protocol payload sources. Both reviewers renewed their verdicts after the test-only HTTP blocker was added at 8930091; each reran the affected transport tests. Five current-head hosted jobs remain required. Base/merge-base: 9f1c0ec75651810a441606b0c08fbdeee824c8d8. Candidate worktree clean.

Strategy: coordinator implementation with read-only protocol research and separate independent reviewers. Source checks do not establish visible latency, readability or physical recovery. External writers across hosts/native users still require operator exclusion.

Hub guide companion: https://github.com/jimmie-potts/agent-device-hub/pull/111. Merged and verified at 0ae1484817593670541587b490e37d762b7f083d. The merged tree equals reviewed candidate ebf2873; all 14 changed paths are guide-only, and both main workflows intentionally exclude them. Current merged-revision checks and runs are empty under that documented exemption. No public publication, installation or device authorization is included.

Merge blocker: run 35530830998 attempt 1 and its one Windows-job retry both timed out in the unchanged media-admission cancellation test (jobs 106131005643 and 106131577073). Other four current-head jobs passed. Retry allowance exhausted; no further rerun scheduled. Issue #30 remains open and blocked.

title: Expose Pixoo through the authenticated shared controller API
body:
Hub clients need a protected controller boundary that preserves Pixoo's existing writer. Add explicitly enabled `/controller/v1` snapshot, command and resumable-event routes using the released controller contract, scoped machine credentials and the existing player/command ledger. Native, browser and MCP clients share request identity and serialized effects; stale intent and uncertain outcomes remain explicit.

Refs #37. Supports power, brightness and guarded saved-playlist playback. Unsupported modes, scenes, zones and previews remain unavailable. Default startup remains simulator. Source-only delivery does not install clients, activate hardware or publish the public guide.

Validation: Node 24.21.0 `npm ci` and `npm run check` pass: 514 tests in 44 files, including all 220 shared contract fixtures, plus 10 workflow fixtures. Playwright Chromium `npm run test:browser` passes all 52 desktop/mobile tests. Focused red/green evidence covers absent routes, command admission, media request attribution, cancellation effects and combined pending capacity. Tests cover authorization/revocation, cross-client contention, retained replay/failures, stale revision/generation, catalog capture, queued cancellation, possible prior effects, cross-client media attribution, cancellation after transmission, shared command/media capacity during upload and between uploads, stream replay/resync/backpressure and bounds. `npm run test:controller` is the reproducible hub-CI compatibility entrypoint. There are 13 current specifications; `gh-37-hub-controller-api` is synchronized and archived on this branch.

Guide companion: https://github.com/jimmie-potts/agent-device-hub/pull/110. Guide synchronization is pending its reviewed merge. Public publication and live verification are separate and outside this source-only request.

Review comparison: base/merge-base `9f1c0ec75651810a441606b0c08fbdeee824c8d8`; head `a87408fd6173b00b7b57ae0fae4ce54f8ec4c489`; `git diff <base>...<head>`. Worktree clean. Independent Standards and Specification review and all five configured current-head CI jobs remain pending. Issue closure requires merged-main CI and guide reconciliation.

Risk: native authentication and concurrent output admission are high impact. Configuration identities are fixed for the process lifetime; no raw destination or filesystem command is exposed. Restart expires old request/feed/clock epochs. Native v1 exposes a bounded 100-playlist catalog and the operations its released schema can express; existing richer local media tools remain available.

Strategy: coordinator implementation and writes, one read-only boundary investigator, separate independent reviewers. No advisor loop. Runtime settings and attributable usage are unexposed where not reported by the host.
